{{Top|leg}}
'''The Lovers' Conflict''' was when the two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]], [[Sharene]] and [[Lodos (moon)|Lodos]], were on opposite sides of the sky. Due to either a biological, psychological, or unknown factor, the violent crime rate on Elrood increased. A similar event on Elrood was known as [[The Lovers' Embrace]], and the [[Painting/Legends|artwork]] "[[The Lovers' Dilemma]]" was displayed on the same planet.
